description: This file defines a Controller class for the checkout cart in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages cart display, item listing, JSON responses for AJAX, adding, editing, and removing items from the cart, and assembles data for the cart view.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller for managing shopping cart actions in OpenCart, including display, listing, AJAX responses, and modifications (add/edit/remove).

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the main cart page, preparing data, and loading the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the cart contents via direct response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the cart content, including products, totals, and messages.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Provides a JSON response with cart data for AJAX operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart based on POST data, with validation and response.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Edits quantity of a cart item identified by a key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cart item by key.
